#version 460

layout(binding = 1, std140) uniform Params
{
    float P0;
    float P1;
    float P2;
    float P3;
    float P4;
    float P5;
    vec2 uRes;
    float uTime;
    float uFC;
    mat4 m0;
    mat4 m1;
    vec3 uLightDir;
    float _p0;
    vec3 uLightColor;
    float _p1;
    vec3 uEyePos;
    float _p2;
} _60;

layout(location = 0) in vec2 vUV;
layout(location = 0) out vec4 outColor;

bool hit(vec3 ro, vec3 rd, float r, inout float t)
{
    float b = dot(ro, rd);
    float c = dot(ro, ro) - (r * r);
    float h = (b * b) - c;
    if (h < 0.0)
    {
        return false;
    }
    h = sqrt(h);
    t = (-b) - h;
    return t > 0.001000000047497451305389404296875;
}

void main()
{
    vec3 eye = _60.uEyePos;
    vec3 fwd = normalize(-eye);
    vec3 rt = normalize(cross(fwd, vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)));
    vec3 up = cross(rt, fwd);
    float ar = _60.uRes.x / _60.uRes.y;
    vec2 uv = (vUV - vec2(0.5)) * 2.0;
    uv.x *= ar;
    vec3 rd = normalize((fwd + ((rt * uv.x) * 0.550000011920928955078125)) + ((up * uv.y) * 0.550000011920928955078125));
    vec3 param = eye;
    vec3 param_1 = rd;
    float param_2 = 1.0;
    float param_3;
    bool _129 = hit(param, param_1, param_2, param_3);
    float t1 = param_3;
    if (!_129)
    {
        outColor = vec4(0.0199999995529651641845703125, 0.0199999995529651641845703125, 0.039999999105930328369140625, 1.0);
        return;
    }
    float b = dot(eye, rd);
    float c = dot(eye, eye) - 1.0;
    float t2 = (-b) + sqrt((b * b) - c);
    vec3 L = normalize(_60.uLightDir);
    float alpha = clamp(1.0 - _60.P0, 0.0500000007450580596923828125, 0.949999988079071044921875);
    vec3 P1 = eye + (rd * max(t1, 0.001000000047497451305389404296875));
    vec3 N1 = normalize(P1);
    vec3 V = normalize(eye - P1);
    float NdV = abs(dot(N1, V));
    float F0 = 0.039999999105930328369140625;
    float fresnel = F0 + ((1.0 - F0) * pow(1.0 - NdV, 5.0));
    vec3 Rfl = reflect(-V, N1);
    vec3 skyTop = vec3(0.550000011920928955078125, 0.7200000286102294921875, 0.949999988079071044921875);
    vec3 skyHorizon = vec3(0.819999992847442626953125, 0.86000001430511474609375, 0.920000016689300537109375);
    vec3 ground = vec3(0.119999997317790985107421875, 0.1599999964237213134765625, 0.2199999988079071044921875);
    float skyT = smoothstep(-0.20000000298023223876953125, 0.300000011920928955078125, Rfl.y);
    vec3 envRefl = mix(ground, mix(skyHorizon, skyTop, vec3(skyT)), vec3(smoothstep(-0.07999999821186065673828125, 0.119999997317790985107421875, Rfl.y)));
    vec3 P2 = eye + (rd * t2);
    vec3 N2 = -normalize(P2);
    float ndl2 = (abs(dot(N2, L)) * 0.5) + 0.5;
    vec3 backCol = vec3(0.039999999105930328369140625, 0.0599999986588954925537109375, 0.100000001490116119384765625) * ndl2;
    vec3 H = normalize(L + V);
    float spec = pow(max(dot(N1, H), 0.0), 8.0);
    vec3 col = mix(backCol, envRefl, vec3(fresnel));
    col += ((vec3(1.0) * spec) * 0.60000002384185791015625);
    outColor = vec4(col * _60.uLightColor, alpha);
}
